withheld_reason.contributions: PERIOD-vs-CUMULATIVE GRAIN (the Harte-2026 / Wolbach-24390 class), BOTH SIDES. The contribution schedule page (p2) EXISTS and its two ruled rows are genuinely BLANK, and it prints its own total 'Total Contributions: $0'. That $0 is the POST-ELECTION PERIOD figure - it equals the cover's contrib current_report of 0 exactly - while the cover's CUMULATIVE contributions, the figure this module publishes, is 10,157.17 (cover last_report 10,157.17 + current 0 = cumulative 10,157.17). So the blank page is a real PERIOD zero, NOT a cycle zero, and shipping it as 'transcribed with zero rows' would assert that a 10,157.17 campaign had no itemizable donors. No rows exist to park. Both figures named: printed page total 0 (period) vs stated cumulative 10,157.17.
withheld_reason.expenditures: PERIOD-vs-CUMULATIVE GRAIN. The expense schedule (p3) prints 'Total amount of expenditures: $424.80' and its 4 rows sum to 424.80 EXACTLY - but 424.80 is the cover's expenditure current_report, not the cumulative 9,642.52 that this module publishes (cover arithmetic closes: last_report 9,217.72 + current 424.80 = cumulative 9,642.52). The ledger is therefore PERIOD-scoped and no sum is claimed. The 4 rows ARE transcribed and parked in withheld_rows so a future grain ruling can be applied without re-reading the page.

contributions.detail: no sum claimed. The schedule page exists and is BLANK with a printed total of $0, but that $0 is the period figure (= cover current_report), not the cumulative 10,157.17 this module states. A period zero is not a cycle zero - see withheld_reason.

expenditures.detail: no sum claimed. The 4 transcribed rows sum to 424.80, closing EXACTLY on the page's own printed total, but 424.80 is the cover's current_report; the cumulative stated figure is 9,642.52. Rows parked pending the owner's grain ruling.

Row-count gate: rowbands detected 3 bands on p2 (1 header + 2 blank rows) and 6 on p3 (1 instruction line, 1 header, 4 data rows) - both match what was read. _meta_itemized.notes: Malena Stevens, County Council, 2020 Post-Election. A clean typed sheet (born-digital-looking laser print, scanned) with a faithful OCR layer. THE WHOLE FILING IS PERIOD-SCOPED ON BOTH SIDES and the cover's three-column arithmetic proves it independently on each side - a stronger, two-sided instance of the 24390 Wolbach case, where only one side was period. Same-candidate cover-differencing: this Post-Election cover's 'last report' column (contrib 10,157.17 / exp 9,217.72) is exactly what the Pre-Election sibling (11110 / 11861, another agent's chunk) should state as its cumulative, so the pair can be differenced end to end once both are read. The four expense rows are all dated 11/6/20, three days after the general election, and are charitable donations of the leftover balance in equal quarters - the classic surplus-disposal pattern. Sheet prints 'Mailing Address' + 'Zipcode' and NO city column, so donor_city/donor_state would be honestly blank here in any case (moot - no contribution rows). No specimen rows, no in-kind schedule, no redactions.
